header: Numbered notes at the foot of an article
note: The element's own note sits under the list. Use it for anything that applies to every source.

notes.title: The number comes from the list position.
notes.description: Reorder the rows and the notes renumber themselves, which is what you need when you add a source mid-article.

notes.title: Each note has an ID to link to.
notes.description: A superscript in the text can link straight to it. The target note is highlighted, so readers see where the link went.

notes.title: Links are optional and show the full URL.
notes.description: Printed in full, so the reference still works on paper.
